final_resume.summary: Software Development Engineer with 2 years of embedded systems and QA experience, specialising in testing BLE devices and automating firmware validation. Proficient in Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Object-Oriented Design principles. Seeking to transition into core software development roles with a focus on scalable systems and end-to-end ownership.

bullets: Designed and executed test cases for BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices, ensuring protocol compliance for wearable product line.
Automated 150 firmware regression test cases using Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day and enabling faster release cycles.
Collaborated with firmware developers to triage and log defects in JIRA during 2-week sprints, improving defect resolution velocity.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Developed C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and persists data to flash storage. Demonstrates embedded systems design, real-time task scheduling, and protocol implementation.

profile_improvement_tips: Strengthen Object-Oriented Design credentials: add a project or bullet demonstrating class hierarchies, design patterns (Factory, Observer, Singleton), or SOLID principles in C++ or Python.

Build Distributed Systems experience: contribute to or create a small project involving multi-threaded communication, message queues, or network protocols (e.g., MQTT, gRPC) to bridge the gap between QA and core SDE work.

Highlight Algorithms and Data Structures: solve and document 5-10 LeetCode-style problems (linked lists, trees, sorting, searching) in C++ and add a brief 'Competitive Programming' or 'DSA Practice' section to show algorithmic thinking.
final_resume.growth_note: Profile is QA-heavy with embedded foundations; JD emphasizes scalable distributed systems and algorithms. Recommend upskilling in system design, multi-threaded architecture, and algorithmic problem-solving before applying to core SDE roles. Current experience is a strong stepping stone but lacks explicit distributed systems or large-scale backend work.
